intent: new composition using existing project style references
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: finished SQUARE 1:1 raster illustration for the "3x3" challenge-format menu card in Beat my track.
Primary request: REDESIGN the concept completely so the image clearly communicates a three-track racing series. Use the supplied two project images ONLY as style and fictional-car design references; do not copy their compositions or car counts.
Composition: one square poster divided into EXACTLY THREE equal-height horizontal scenic panels, separated by two very thin straight navy rules. Each panel is a separate, believable real-world race location at ground level, not a physical floor of one structure. No floating tracks, stacked flyovers, dioramas, track-shaped platforms, impossible architecture, branching route maps or UI diagram.
Panel 1, upper third: a grounded winding forest circuit, pine trees and rocky banks, cool green/blue late daylight.
Panel 2, middle third: a grounded winding desert circuit with compacted sandy road and low sandy shoulders between warm muted dunes under a pale sky.
Panel 3, lower third: a grounded winding winter circuit with pale snowbanks, dark fir trees and distant snowy hills in cool blue daylight.
Across all three scenes, repeat the SAME coherent fictional ivory-and-navy boxy classic rally hatchback from reference image 1, exactly ONE car per panel (exactly THREE cars total), seen from an attractive elevated front three-quarter view at a modest black-and-white painted start line. All four wheels are physically plausible, planted on the road; maintain identical car design, wheelbase, livery, four round front lamps and helmeted driver across the three scenes. Cars read as the same entrant on three different tracks. Feature the car large enough to read in a small menu card, about one third of each panel width, keep the whole car and its immediate road context inside each panel. Each road continues naturally behind the car into a different distinct bend in its own environment. Three panels have consistent camera language, comparable car scale and balanced visual weight.
Place one compact mechanically plausible freestanding starter board in each panel, with EXACTLY THREE small circular amber lenses in a horizontal row, simple metal housing and a grounded support, always in the same unobtrusive position beside the start. No other glowing circles or decorative markers. The game's own caption explains three tries on each track.
Style/medium: mature CEL-SHADED 3D game illustration matching reference 1's car and reference 2's environment technique: believable dimensional geometry, two or three broad clean colour/shadow planes per material, crisp selective dark silhouette and structural edges, matte surfaces, flat controlled highlights, readable grounded cast shadows, natural restrained palette. Simplify foliage, stones, asphalt and clouds into large authored 3D forms. Visibly clean non-photorealistic 3D, no painterly texture, no photographic microtexture, no gloss/bloom, no motion streaks, no toy proportions.
Text: NO words, letters, numbers, headings, logos or watermark anywhere. Native UI adds the 3x3 title separately.
All THREE scenes must remain distinct, complete and readable together as a single coherent scenic poster. Fill the square edge-to-edge; no outer white margin, no paper/table/workbench, no large footer.
design: Three equal horizontal racing scenes: forest, desert and winter. Same ivory/navy fictional hatchback at three grounded starts, with one three-lens starter board at each. Existing native text explains three tracks and three tries each.
reference_policy: Project-generated original assets guide style and car identity. Previous stacked-road versions remain historical.
